purpose: physical compatibility bridge for the leading R4 representation, leading exact R5 update semantics, and first R6 turn-to-river public-state transfer
solver_semantics: historical/OpenSpiel-style post-update discounted alternating CFR: add instantaneous regret, then discount the updated cumulative regret; quadratic average weighting
river_child_selection: highest exact marginal public chance mass after card removal; ties by encoded river card id
reference_rule: exact-combo ALT_DCFR_150_0_2 reference is trained once per selected river child and excluded from each candidate wall-clock budget
candidate_rule: each representation trains p0-restricted, p1-restricted and joint abstract ALT_DCFR_150_0_2 states in equal-iteration round-robin chunks until the same candidate-training wall-clock budget is reached
memory_rule: each candidate/river-child executes in a fresh subprocess and records native/fallback peak working-set plus process affinity
decision_rule: no post-hoc scalar score; matchup_cluster8 may be frozen only if its held-out fidelity advantage survives the turn-to-river bridge without a material equal-wall-clock throughput or memory penalty versus equity8
scope_warning: this gate validates compatibility of representation, exact alternating discounted update semantics, and the first public turn-to-river chance-transfer contract. It does not by itself select the final sampled production traversal, complete turn betting/resolving, or mark R6 PASS.
